decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit at the core of the firm's plate exchanger know-how, so it can interpret feedback and refine the line, although the product's absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.
The marine box cooler builds on deep water-cooling expertise and a reported major market share, giving strong related knowledge and positive market signals despite less website visibility recently.

The single marine cooling unit draws on the same marine competence and service network, but as a single model with no visibility since 2018 it is more exposed to being folded into the box cooler line.

The compact oil cooler extends existing exchanger engineering into adjacent applications where manufacturing and service learning apply directly, though its weak recent visibility suggests only moderate traction.
